murim.cold_iron.refuse: The cold iron does not yield: only strength above Peak can break it
murim.cold_iron.no_qi: The cold iron does not yield: a strike needs full qi
murim.seal.door.locked: The cold iron door is locked
murim.seal.door.vault: The vault door does not open. Touch the seal beside it and perform what is engraved
murim.seal.door.penance: Only the elders open the penance cave
murim.vault.known: The seal knows you — the door opens
murim.vault.engraving: Engraved on the seal: %s. Perform it here, in order.
murim.vault.broken: The engraving dims: it wanted «%s». The ladder broke — start over.
murim.vault.left: You stepped away from the seal — the trial ends
murim.vault.idle: The seal has gone cold — the trial ends
murim.vault.passed: The last rung falls into place. The seal flares, and the cold iron door swings aside — from now on it knows you.
murim.penance.rampage: You have crossed the line. An elder is coming to stop your rampage.
murim.penance.suppressed: %s: “Kneel. Your qi is sealed. You will serve your sentence in the penance cave.”
murim.penance.repeat_refusal: Your recent sentence taught you nothing. This time, refusal will not be accepted.
murim.penance.cell_unavailable: The seal holds you in place. The elder is waiting for a cell to become available.
murim.penance.warn.assault: %s: «One does not raise a hand on a brother outside a spar. Next time — the penance cave.»
murim.penance.warn.trespass: %s: «Force your way where you are not allowed once more, and you go to the penance cave.»
murim.penance.summoned: The elders call you to account. An elder or guard will approach to read the sentence; merit spending and access to restricted areas are suspended.
murim.penance.no_cave: No penance cave was found — this time you are let go.
murim.penance.sentenced: The grille shuts behind you. %s days in the dark — or sooner, after %s min of meditation. Meditation is faster here.
murim.penance.released: An elder unlocks the entrance: your penance is over.
murim.penance.free: The penance stone. Punishment is served here.
murim.penance.back: One does not leave the penance cave — you are brought back
dialogue.murim.penance.sentence: You broke the mountain’s rules again. The penance cave: %s days in the dark, or %s min of meditation. Refusing costs %s merit. If you recently served a sentence, the elder will enforce this one.
dialogue.murim.tae_gyun.exchange: The ledger says you have %s merit to spend. The sect pays its own fairly — not generously.
dialogue.murim.tae_gyun.exchange_more: Anything else? You have %s merit left.
dialogue.murim.merit.page: Page of the Seven Plum Blossoms — %s merit
dialogue.murim.merit.scriptures: Pass to the Hall of Scriptures — %s merit
dialogue.murim.merit.got.scriptures: a pass to the Hall of Scriptures
dialogue.murim.gyeong_cho.pills: Pills are earned, not bought. You have %s merit — what do you need?
murim.sect.merit.merit: Not enough merit: needs %s, you have %s
murim.sect.merit.standing: Not for you yet: needs standing «%3$s»
murim.sect.merit.outsider: Only disciples of Mount Hua exchange merit.
murim.sect.merit.unknown: Nothing like that in the ledger.
dialogue.murim.senior.opt.review: Enter me in the disciples' review
dialogue.murim.senior.review: Noted. The review is on the training square in %s day(s) — 0 means today, before the elders' council. Latecomers lose.
murim.sect.review.too_young: The review is for third-class disciples and above. Pass the Master's first lesson first.
murim.sect.review.signed: You are entered in the disciples' review: in %s day(s), on the training square after the ledger report.
murim.sect.review.signed_today: You are entered: the review is today on the training square, before the elders' council.
murim.sect.review.your_bout: Your review bout: against %s. Go to the ring on the training square.
murim.sect.review.champion: %s wins the disciples' review. The Leader nods.
murim.sect.review.no_show: You did not come to the ring — %s wins by default.
murim.sect.review.closed: The review ended unfinished: the elders' council has begun.
murim.sect.approval.review: Leader Tae Hwi approves of you: the review's winner has earned the sect's trust.
murim.sect.approval.streak: Leader Tae Hwi recognises your seven full practice days, with any breaks. You have his approval.
murim.gallery.line: You hold the sword like a farmer holds a hoe. Before the plum blossoms bloom for you, your wrists must learn patience: a thousand cuts at dawn, and not one of them careless.
murim.gallery.option1: I will practise until the blossoms fall, Elder.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.opt.talk: May I ask you something, senior?
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.greet1: Junior. Back in the training yard? Good. A sword rusts faster than you think.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.greet2: Stand up straight when you speak to a senior. …There. Now talk.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.greet3: I'm the first disciple of the second generation. If you have a question, ask me, not Bok Manseok.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.greet4: Want to be noticed? Win the weekly review. Then I'll stop going easy on you.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.graduate1: A White Plum graduate, eh? Now you're almost on par with the second generation. Almost.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.graduate2: You don't fall off the poles like you did when you first arrived. Don't get cocky — I remember every fall.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.champion1: The review champion. Hm. I won't congratulate you — tomorrow you're nobody again until you prove otherwise.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.champion2: Now all the juniors want to fight you. Don't let them down. Or me. I'm not holding back anymore.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.night1: …You didn't see me training at night. Understood? No one should think I need the extra practice.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.night2: Stars over Lotus Peak. On a night like this I wish the mountain were crowded with disciples again.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.night_secret: Good. Then I'll go easy on you in tomorrow's sparring session. A little.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.opt.sect: How do you see the sect?
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.opt.progress: How do you think I'm doing?
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.t_sect: The sect is poor, not weak. Weakness is when you stop counting your mistakes. I count them. My own first.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.t_huayin: Huayin down below looks at us like debtors. One day I want people to climb up here for advice, not for debts. Don't ask me more than that.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.t_others: Mok Hayeon is stronger than she looks and says less than she should. Ham Doyun carries the whole third generation on his back. And Bok Manseok… Bok Manseok is loud.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.p_novice: You're a novice. Weak legs, tense shoulders. Pass the master's lesson, then we'll talk.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.p_disciple: A third-class disciple. Not bad. Land three clean strikes on one of us and you'll graduate from the White Plum.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.p_graduate: You've graduated from the White Plum. From here on, you'll learn from the reviews and nights in the training yard. Keep at it.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.opt.talk: Senior, may I ask you something?
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.night1: Can't sleep. My sword rang false today.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.night2: You can hear the sword better at night.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.friend1: I still have the petals. Pressed in a book.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.opt.sword: Why do you never put your sword down?
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.opt.cheon: What do you think of Seo Rang?
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.t_sword: The sword doesn't lie. People do.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.t_plum: They say a good sword blooms. I don't look. I listen: a true strike rings differently.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.opt.find: Want me to find you some blossoms?
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.favour_ask: …Pink petals. Under the cherry trees, down in the valley. For bookmarks in my book of forms. If it's no trouble.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.favour_done: …Good ones. One for each form. Thank you.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.t_cheon: Precise. Too fond of writing down other people's mistakes.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.t_mine_plum: Seven Plum Blossoms. Wrist too slow. A thousand more times.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.t_mine_basic: Not a sword yet. A stick. Train.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.opt.paper: Here's the paper for the log
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.formation1: Get to the end of the row, quick! The master's already watching.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.formation2: Keep the beat. If you lose it, watch my sword.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.missed: You missed formation! The master asked about you. I said you had a stomachache. Don't make me lie twice.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.meal1: Eat all of it. Train on an empty stomach and you'll end up seeing the healer.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.meal2: Bok Manseok tried begging for a second bowl again. If you see him, stop him.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.night1: Why aren't you asleep? Formation tomorrow. …Me? I'm checking everyone's in bed.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.greet1: %s! Have you eaten? You'll regret training on an empty stomach.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.greet2: If you see Bok Manseok, tell him the master's looking for him. Better he panics now than later.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.greet3: My head hurts again. No, no, it's fine. Looking after the third generation just gives me forty things to worry about.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.champion: %s, you won the review! I'm… I'm proud of you. Just don't let Bok Manseok throw a party — we can't afford a party.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.topics: Of course. What's on your mind?
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.t_sect: The treasury's empty, the dormitory roof leaks, and Elder Tae Gyun hands out paper one sheet at a time. But we hold on. I write to my sisters about it and pretend it's all fine.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.favour_ask: Really? The third generation's practice log is falling apart. Bring me three sheets of paper and I'll copy it out before the master notices.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.favour_done: You're a lifesaver! Now the log will last till spring. Thank you, %s.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.t_manseok: Bok Manseok's a good one. Loud, always charging in first, but good. If he dozes off in meditation again, give him a nudge, will you?
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.p_novice: Show the master you've learned the Six Harmonies. Want me to help you after supper?
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.p_disciple: You're a third-class disciple now. Don't rush — and sign up for the review with Senior Seo Rang.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.p_graduate: You've overtaken me. …No, really, I'm glad. Just give me a little time to catch up.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.formation1: Third form! No, fourth! Who cares — swing!
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.formation2: Stand next to me, I'll show you how it's done. Well, how I do it.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.meal1: Are you going to finish that? No? Great!
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.meal2: Porridge and nuts — breakfast of champions. That's what I tell myself.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.night1: Shh! I'm not sleeping, I'm… meditating lying down. It's a technique.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.night2: If Ham Doyun asks, I've been in bed since sunset.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.greet1: %s! Let's fight! Just a friendly spar. We'll go easy. Come on!
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.greet2: You know who's the fastest in the third generation? Me. You know who disagrees? Everyone else.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.greet3: I'd kill for a piece of real bread right now. Well, not kill. Beat someone up, maybe.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.champion1: You won the review! You! I knew it! …Okay, I didn't. But I bet my breakfast on you!
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.champion2: Now everyone wants to fight you. I'm first in line, got it?
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.friend1: If you're in the valley again — you know what I like. Bread. I like bread.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.topics: Ooh, ask away! I know everything. Well, almost.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.opt.news: What's the word on the mountain?
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.opt.seniors: What do you think of the seniors?
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.t_seniors: Seo Rang writes all our slips in a notebook — I've filled a second one by myself. Mok Hayeon is scary. In a good way. I wouldn't fight her. Not even for a persimmon.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.p_novice: You? Still green. Like me last year. Well, like me last week.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.p_disciple: You've gotten better. It's annoying. Let's fight!
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.p_graduate: A graduate! You've pulled ahead of me! That's temporary. Very temporary.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.favour_ask: Always! Bring me some bread from the valley, would you? Just don't tell Ham Doyun — he'll call it a breach of discipline.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.favour_done: Bread! Real bread! %s, you're family now. For life. Well, until the next review.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.meal1: From the kitchen to the training yard is three hundred and twelve steps. I counted. Eat faster.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.evening1: In the evenings Elder Tae Gyun sometimes calls me in to check the ledgers. Numbers calm me better than meditation.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.greet1: Junior. If you're heading to the treasury, don't tell Elder Tae Gyun you saw me idle.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.greet2: Forty mouths, one kitchen and not a single rich patron. I did the math.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.greet3: They say Seo Rang has talent. I have a map of every path on this mountain. That's useful too.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.champion: Review champion! Five merit, the Leader's approval… Do you have any idea what that's worth in silver? I do.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.topics: Ask, but make it quick. Time is money too.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.opt.merit: What should I save my merit for?
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.opt.others: Who's who in the second generation?
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.t_money: The sect has more debts than disciples. Donations to Steward Mun make a difference — every silver coin counts.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.opt.help: How can I help the treasury?
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.favour_ask: We're out of ink. Bring me a couple of ink sacs — there are squid in the lake at the foot of the mountain. The Elder will be pleased, and I'll be even more so.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.favour_done: Excellent. I'll note it in the ledger: 'Third-generation disciple — two merit for helping the treasury.' …Fine, one.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.t_merit: You've got %s merit. Save up for a sword from Elder Tae Gyun — twenty merit and it's yours. A sound investment.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.t_others: Seo Ho hauls as much firewood as three men and eats as much as five. Mok Hayeon barely eats at all — I think she lives on training.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.opt.talk: Can I ask you something, senior?
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.meal1: Another bowl? No, it's not greed. It's the firewood. I haul it.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.night1: It's peaceful on the mountain at night. Just wind and pines. Go to sleep — I'll keep watch.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.greet1: Ah, junior. Need a hand carrying something? I'm heading that way anyway.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.greet2: My sword's heavy and I'm slow on the uptake. But I never miss.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.greet3: People laugh at me sometimes. Let them. I'll still haul a cart up the cliff faster than any of them.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.champion: Heard you won the review. I'm glad. Truly. Come on, my treat — I've got a flatbread stashed away.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.topics: Ask. I'll answer if I know.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.t_strength_low: Eat, sleep, climb the wall. Every day. Qi favours those who don't give up.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.t_strength_high: You're Second Rate now, same as us. From here on, strength isn't in your arms. It's in how much you can endure.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.t_watch: Seven of us, two posts. Two by day, two by night. Anyone on night watch sleeps till noon. Don't wake them — Seo Gi bites.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.t_others: Seo Rang is always thinking. Seo Gyu is always counting. I just do things. Someone has to.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.opt.help: Can I help you with something?
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.favour_ask: The kitchen needs firewood. Bring eight logs and Cook Kim will thank us both.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.favour_done: Now that's a load! You're stronger than you look. I'll take it to the cook and tell him it's from you.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.opt.talk: May I ask you something, Elder?
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.busy: The council only receives juniors by invitation, child. Go to Master Gyeong Pil.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.formation: I'm watching the formation. There used to be twenty rows. Now there are four. But the disciples stand just as straight.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.evening: Evening is for tea and the board. Tae Gyun refused to play again: says his books have no column for a draw.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.night: Can't sleep — it's my age. The stars over Lotus Peak are the same ones the Plum Blossom Sword Saint saw. That's a comfort.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.greet1: Ah, child. Sit, if you're not in a hurry. Old men are rarely asked anything.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.greet2: The wind's from the west today. The annals say that on a day like this, a hundred years ago… well, never mind. What is it?
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.friend: Your candle lasted a whole chapter of the annals. Your name is there, in the margin.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.champion: I heard about the review. The Leader smiled through the whole council meeting — first time in ten years. Thank you for that, child.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.trusted: You're someone the sect trusts now. Don't be too quick to celebrate: trust is a burden too.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.topics: Ask. An old man has time, and you have questions.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.opt.past: What was the sect like before?
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.opt.path: What should my next step be?
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.t_past: A hundred years ago three hundred disciples lived on this mountain. Then came three dry years, a plague in the valley and a lawsuit with Huayin over land: the sect sold half its fields and its best books. We didn't fall in battle. We grew poor — that's slower, and more shameful.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.opt.saint: Who was the Plum Blossom Sword Saint?
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.t_saint: The chronicles keep no name — only the title. A hundred years ago he left this mountain for the war against the Heavenly Demon and cut him down on the summit of the Ten Thousand Mountains. He never came back. They say the petals on his sword never fell, not even in winter.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.favour_ask: I do, child. I copy them out in the evenings. But candles are dear here — Tae Gyun hands out one a month. If you find a candle, an old man would be grateful.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.favour_done: Light. Thank you, child. I'll write your name in the margin, so those who come after know who held the candle.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.t_council: Six seats: the Leader, three elders, Gyeong Cho and Gyeong Tak. We decide what the money will cover and what it won't. Mostly it won't.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.t_path_low: Don't rush to learn advanced techniques. Master the Six Harmonies and you'll have a solid foundation. A pretty roof can't replace that.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.t_path_high: You've graduated from the White Plum. Now seek your own plum blossom — it blooms differently for every swordsman.
npc.murim.tae_seong.title: Council Elder
dialogue.murim.elder.greet2: Mount Hua has stood a thousand years. It'll stand a thousand more, if you lot don't get lazy.
dialogue.murim.elder.greet3: A bow isn't weakness, child. It's remembering those who came before you.
dialogue.murim.elder.formation1: Stay in line, child. Elders don't watch the sword — they watch how you stand.
dialogue.murim.elder.evening1: The mountain speaks softly in the evening. Listen to it — and to yourself while you're at it.
dialogue.murim.elder.night1: Elders sleep at night too, child. Sometimes.
dialogue.murim.elder.advice1: The shoulder leads the sword, the breath leads the shoulder. Start with the breath.
dialogue.murim.elder.advice2: If you lose, bow and remember how. If you win, bow and forget it.
dialogue.murim.elder.advice3: Don't ask how many stars are left. Ask whether you're standing straight.
dialogue.murim.trait.lazy.1: Meditation is sitting with your eyes closed. I'm a master of it. Especially after lunch.
dialogue.murim.trait.lazy.2: A hundred strikes on the dummy? What if I hit it really hard ten times — does that count?
dialogue.murim.trait.lazy.3: Know the best spot on the mountain? Under the pine behind the kitchen. The master never looks there.
dialogue.murim.trait.lazy.4: Getting up at dawn is cruel. Why can't we train at noon like normal people?
dialogue.murim.trait.lazy.5: I'm not lazy. I'm conserving my strength. For what, I haven't decided.
dialogue.murim.trait.lazy.won: %s, you won the review… How much did you train for that? No, don't tell me, I already feel ill.
dialogue.murim.rumour.trait.lazy: %s fell asleep in meditation again. Snored so loud the master lost count.
dialogue.murim.trait.eager.1: I got up before the bell and ran to Lotus Peak! Twice! Well, one and a half times.
dialogue.murim.trait.eager.2: The master said my stance is a finger's width lower. A whole finger's width!
dialogue.murim.trait.eager.3: Want to run the forms together after supper? I'll count, you strike. Or the other way round!
dialogue.murim.trait.eager.4: Someday my sword will bloom with plum blossoms. I check every evening. Not yet.
dialogue.murim.trait.eager.5: A hundred more strikes and I'm a hundred strikes better than this morning. Simple arithmetic!
dialogue.murim.trait.eager.won: %s, teach me! How did you win the review? What do you eat? When do you get up?
dialogue.murim.rumour.trait.eager: %s was training again while everyone else slept. You can see his stance all the way from the kitchen.
dialogue.murim.trait.homesick.1: Back home they're picking persimmons now. Mother's probably drying them on the roof.
dialogue.murim.trait.homesick.2: I've been writing a letter home for three months. Can't work out how to say everything's fine without lying.
dialogue.murim.trait.homesick.3: In my village they said Mount Hua was a great sect. …It is great. Just poor.
dialogue.murim.trait.homesick.4: When the wind blows from the south, it smells of the river. Like home.
dialogue.murim.trait.homesick.5: My little brother thinks I fly above the clouds up here. I won't disappoint him.
dialogue.murim.trait.homesick.won: %s, I'm writing home that I train alongside the review champion. At least one piece of news will be true.
dialogue.murim.rumour.trait.homesick: %s is sitting at the cliff's edge in the evenings again, looking toward home. Best leave him be.
dialogue.murim.trait.gossip.1: They say Elder Tae Gyun once copied out the whole ledger again because of a single blot. Twice.
dialogue.murim.trait.gossip.2: Did you hear? The Leader has a hidden vault. What's in it, I don't know. But I'll find out.
dialogue.murim.trait.gossip.3: Just between us: Seo Rang keeps a notebook of all our mistakes. My page is the third one. The whole page.
dialogue.murim.trait.gossip.4: I know everything about everyone. Ask me anything. No, I won't tell you about myself.
dialogue.murim.trait.gossip.5: Cook Kim only puts nuts in the porridge when the elder isn't looking. That's why there are so few.
dialogue.murim.trait.gossip.won: %s, everyone's been talking about you since the review! Well, I have. A lot.
dialogue.murim.rumour.trait.gossip: %s knows everything about everyone. Whatever happens on the mountain, he's the first to hear.
dialogue.murim.trait.rival.1: You've gotten faster. I don't like it. Let's see how much.
dialogue.murim.trait.rival.2: Next review, I'll be in the bracket. And you won't get past me.
dialogue.murim.trait.rival.3: I count your strikes in formation. You slipped on the seventh. I didn't.
dialogue.murim.trait.rival.4: Don't think you're better just because the seniors praise you. Praise means they expected less.
dialogue.murim.trait.rival.5: I'll beat you to Lotus Peak. Tomorrow. At dawn. Don't be late.
dialogue.murim.trait.rival.won: You won the review, %s. Enjoy it while it lasts. Next time I'll be ready.
dialogue.murim.rumour.trait.rival: %s swears he'll win the next review. Same promise every week.
dialogue.murim.trait.admirer.1: Did you see how Senior Seo Rang holds his sword? Like a brush. I tried — mine looks like a broom.
dialogue.murim.trait.admirer.2: Master Gyeong Pil used to be a calligrapher. He says a strike is like a brushstroke: once, and no corrections.
dialogue.murim.trait.admirer.3: They say the Plum Blossom Sword Saint cut down the Heavenly Demon himself. I'd give anything for one look at his sword…
dialogue.murim.trait.admirer.4: Mok Hayeon trains even in the rain. I watched. Well, from under the eaves.
dialogue.murim.trait.admirer.5: How are you improving so fast? Will you show me your stance later? I'll just watch.
dialogue.murim.trait.admirer.won: %s! The review champion is talking to me! Can I… can I stand next to you in formation?
dialogue.murim.rumour.trait.admirer: %s trails after the seniors and writes down how they hold their swords.
dialogue.murim.trait.timid.1: Oh! You… you startled me. No, it's fine. I was just… standing here.
dialogue.murim.trait.timid.2: I don't like sparring. What if I hit someone? Or someone hits me?
dialogue.murim.trait.timid.3: Senior Seo Rang looked at me today. I spent an hour wondering what I'd done wrong.
dialogue.murim.trait.timid.4: Something rustles on the mountain at night. Probably the wind. Probably.
dialogue.murim.trait.timid.5: If the master asks, I was at formation. I really was. Second row. At the back.
dialogue.murim.trait.timid.won: You won the review, %s… I'd have just collapsed in the ring. From fright. You're brave.
dialogue.murim.rumour.trait.timid: As soon as sparring was announced, %s went into hiding in the kitchen again. The cook kept quiet.
dialogue.murim.trait.glutton.1: Can't wait for supper. No, I didn't eat anything at lunch. Well, almost nothing.
dialogue.murim.trait.glutton.2: Porridge with nuts is the only technique I've mastered all the way to the final star.
dialogue.murim.trait.glutton.3: Down in Huayin they sell meat buns. I can smell them from here. Honestly.
dialogue.murim.trait.glutton.4: Cook Kim said if I ask for seconds one more time, he'll boil me instead. I think he was joking.
dialogue.murim.trait.glutton.5: They say qi gathers in the dantian. Mine's only got rice in it so far.
dialogue.murim.trait.glutton.won: %s, do review champions get double portions? No? Then what's the point of winning…
dialogue.murim.rumour.trait.glutton: %s is asking for seconds again. The cook's threatening to put him on kitchen duty for good.
dialogue.murim.rumour.guard_night: %s and %s have the night watch tonight. Go wandering and they won't let you through.
dialogue.murim.rumour.guard_me: I've got the night watch tonight, with %s. So don't wake me before noon tomorrow.
dialogue.murim.rumour.guard_day: %s and %s are posted at the main hall and the treasury today. Don't go poking around there without a reason.
dialogue.murim.rumour.slept: %s and %s were on night watch. Keep it down near the dormitory — they sleep till noon.
dialogue.murim.rumour.review_winner: %s won the last review. They say the final was a good one.
dialogue.murim.rumour.review_me: Did you see the review? I won the last one! Well, I got a bit lucky.
dialogue.murim.rumour.review_you: Everyone's still talking about how you won the review, %s. Even Mok Hayeon nodded. Nodded!
dialogue.murim.rumour.review_soon: The review's %s days off. Everyone's already on edge.
dialogue.murim.rumour.skipped: %s slept through formation. Master Gyeong Pil sent him to haul water until lunch.
dialogue.murim.rumour.you_skipped: %s, you weren't at formation. The master noticed. The master always notices.
dialogue.murim.person.seo_rang: I am Seo Rang, senior disciple of the second generation. I keep a notebook, and you are already in it.
dialogue.murim.person.mok_hayeon: …Mok Hayeon. I listen to how the sword rings.
dialogue.murim.person.seo_gyu: I'm Seo Gyu. I know how many steps lead from the gate to the summit. And how many of them wobble.
dialogue.murim.person.seo_ho: The name's Seo Ho. Back home they said I'm as strong as an ox and just as stubborn.
dialogue.murim.person.seo_mu: I'm Seo Mu. Want to know something? Ask me. Want to hide something? Definitely ask me.
dialogue.murim.person.seo_ryeong: Seo Ryeong. I used to do nothing but stand guard, and now I'm a disciple again. It's better this way — more training!
dialogue.murim.person.seo_gi: Seo Gi. If my eyes are closed on watch, I'm listening. Very carefully.
dialogue.murim.person.seo_jin: Seo Jin. Seo Rang's the senior, but I picked up a sword a month before he did. He remembers.
dialogue.murim.person.ham_doyun: I'm Ham Doyun. If anything breaks in the third generation, I'm the first one they come to.
dialogue.murim.person.bok_manseok: Bok Manseok! Three dried persimmons says you'll remember the name.
dialogue.murim.person.disciple_a: Yul Mun. I came up the mountain the same day as Yul Nam. We've been arguing ever since about who got here first.
dialogue.murim.person.disciple_b: Yul Nam. Yul Mun will tell you he got here first. Don't believe him. It was me — by half a step.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_jin: Yul Jin. I'm from a fishing village on the Yellow River. Everything's fine here, except there's no fish.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_seok: Yul Seok. My mother runs an eatery in Xi'an. So I know what real food tastes like. It's torture.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_pyo: Yul Pyo. The master says I have a talent. A talent for finding somewhere to sit.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_il: Yul Il. I carved a little wooden sword just like Senior Seo Rang's. Don't tell anyone.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_yeon: Yul Yeon. I know which days the porridge is thicker: the days Steward Mun goes down to market. It matters.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_gwang: Yul Gwang. I've got sharp ears. Too sharp — once I heard what the master says about me.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_hae: Yul Hae. Nobody in my village could ever out-wrestle me. Here, every other disciple can. It drives me mad.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_do: Yul Do. I came up the mountain because I once saw a Mount Hua disciple drive off bandits. I want to be like him.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_rim: Yul Rim. My father's a woodcutter. I ran up here to get away from the axe. Turns out the sword is heavier.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_su: Ch-Yul Su. I'm… I'm a disciple too. I just stand at the edge.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_bin: Yul Bin. I'm from a merchant family. Father thought they'd teach me courage here. So far they've only taught me to run.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_san: Yul San. I've barely been here any time at all, and I already know all ten forms. Well, nine and a half.
dialogue.murim.person.yul_ak: Yul Ak. 'Ak' means 'peak'. Mother had hopes. I'm still at the foot of it.
dialogue.murim.cook.serving1: Line up! Seniors first, juniors — no whining.
dialogue.murim.cook.serving2: Another spoonful? Go on. Elder Tae Gyun doesn't count porridge — only paper and candles.
dialogue.murim.water_carrier.morning1: Twenty buckets before breakfast. The well is deep, the mountain is steep, and I'm still alive.
dialogue.murim.water_carrier.morning2: The disciples shout through their drills, and I haul water. Everyone has their own training.
dialogue.murim.porter.hauling1: Rice sacks from Huayin. Full going up, empty going down. My whole life.
dialogue.murim.porter.hauling2: The disciples climb walls for strength. I climb them for wages. Our legs ache the same.
dialogue.murim.gardener.garden1: Ginseng likes shade and quiet. Tell your lot to stop running through the beds.
dialogue.murim.gardener.garden2: Healer Gyeong Cho wants more herbs again. After the spars, bruises bloom on the disciples like plum blossoms.
dialogue.murim.sweeper.sweeping1: Plum petals are lovely — until you're sweeping them for the third time this morning.
dialogue.murim.sweeper.sweeping2: The yard's empty in the evening. Best time for sweeping. And for thinking.
dialogue.murim.steward.accounts1: A donation? No? Then don't block my light — I'm counting.
dialogue.murim.steward.accounts2: The Huayin merchants have raised the price of salt again. I'm writing it down so I'll know whom to grumble at later.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_cho.clinic1: Sparring's started — they'll be carrying people in here soon. Take a seat while you're here. Show me your arm.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_cho.clinic2: Pills don't grow on trees. Well, they do — very slowly.
dialogue.murim.tae_gyun.evening1: Evening. Time to balance the books. We've survived another day — and almost broken even.
dialogue.murim.tae_gyun.evening2: Don't touch the candle. One candle lasts a month. Read in daylight.
dialogue.murim.tae_rok.training1: I've been watching you train. Badly. But better than yesterday.
dialogue.murim.tae_rok.training2: Lower your stance. Lower. There. Now hold it until supper.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_tak.gate1: While the second generation is in the training yard, I guard the gate. No stranger gets past — and no junior without a reason.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_tak.gate2: The Leader asked me to pass this on: the review isn't about fighting, it's about order. Remember that.
dialogue.murim.gatekeeper.member_night1: The trail's slippery at night. Mind your step — I'll light the way.
dialogue.murim.gatekeeper.member_night2: Late again? The master won't hear of it. Not from me.
dialogue.murim.leader.member_evening1: Evening. The accounts are balanced, the disciples are fed. For the head of this mountain, that's already a good day.
dialogue.murim.leader.member_evening2: Sit, if you like. I enjoy listening to the mountain go quiet.
dialogue.murim.mentor.again_extra1: Legs not shaking? Then you didn't run enough. I'm joking. Half joking.
dialogue.murim.mentor.again_extra2: I've taught the third generation for six years. I've had more hopeless pupils than you. So far.
dialogue.murim.rumour.review_today: The review's today! Whoever's in the bracket is already shaking. So is everyone who isn't.
murim.bubble.meal.1: The rice is too salty today.
murim.bubble.meal.5: The cook is in a good mood.
murim.bubble.evening.1: My legs ache from the poles.
murim.bubble.evening.5: They say there's a fair in Huayin.
murim.bubble.evening.6: Hear that? Wind off the peak.
murim.bubble.reply.4: I wish I had your problems.
murim.bubble.guard_night.5: Can't wait for the shift change.
murim.bubble.heal_start.2: Who did this? Let me look.
murim.bubble.trait.gossip.2: They say the leader is angry.
murim.bubble.trait.admirer.2: I want to be like Seo Rang.
murim.bubble.trait.timid.1: Hope they don't call on me…

npc.murim.first.title: Disciple, first generation
dialogue.murim.first.busy1: Later. I'm in the middle of a form.
dialogue.murim.first.formation1: Second row, your elbows are drifting again. Junior, fall in — I'm watching you too.
dialogue.murim.first.formation2: Master Gyeong Pil sees the front. I see the back. Nobody hides in the ranks.
dialogue.murim.first.meal1: Eat. Rice doesn't get warmer while you stare at it.
dialogue.murim.first.meal2: Twenty years ago this hall fed six people. Be glad the benches are crowded.
dialogue.murim.first.night1: Lights out, junior. The bell won't wait for you at dawn.
dialogue.murim.first.evening1: The second generation meditates behind us. If I open my eyes, so do they. So I don't.
dialogue.murim.first.evening2: Sit if you want. Breathe from the belly, not the shoulders.
dialogue.murim.first.greet1: Junior. You walk like someone who skipped the morning ranks.
dialogue.murim.first.greet2: The second generation thinks they're seniors. Then they meet us.
dialogue.murim.first.bowed: Good. Straight back, eyes down. Now you look like Mount Hua.
dialogue.murim.first.advice1: Your weight sits on your heels. A plum branch bends at the root, not the tip. Push from the ground.
dialogue.murim.first.advice2: You pull the sword back before the strike lands. Finish the line first, then think about the next one.
dialogue.murim.first.advice3: Too much shoulder. Let the wrist do the work and the shoulder just watch.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.greet1: Junior. Master Gyeong Pil asked me to keep an eye on the third generation. That includes you.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.greet2: No need to rush. A form done slowly and right beats ten done fast.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.advice: Count your breaths through the form. When the count breaks, so does the form. Find where it breaks.
dialogue.murim.person.gyeong_on: I'm Gyeong On. I speak little and repeat myself less. Listen the first time.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.greet1: You. Your stance at the ranks this morning — I've seen sturdier scarecrows.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.greet2: If you've got time to talk, you've got time for another hundred cuts.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.advice: Again. And again. When your arms stop shaking, come back and I'll tell you the next mistake.
dialogue.murim.person.gyeong_dan: Gyeong Dan. The juniors say I'm harsh. The juniors who listened to me are now second generation.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.greet1: You came up the left path today. The third step from the bend is loose — you stepped around it. Good.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.greet2: I watch first and swing later. Most people do it the other way round.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.advice: You blink before every strike. An opponent who sees that knows when you'll move.
dialogue.murim.person.gyeong_ha: I'm Gyeong Ha. Before the sword I gathered herbs on these cliffs. I still know where every ledge crumbles.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ryun.greet1: Ha! A new face. Did the kitchen give you the burnt rice yet? It's tradition.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ryun.greet2: Back in the lean years we trained on one bowl of gruel a day. You lot have it easy. Good — train harder.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ryun.advice: Smile when you spar. Not to mock them — a tight face makes tight shoulders.
dialogue.murim.person.gyeong_ryun: Gyeong Ryun. I've been on this mountain longer than the bell. Well, the new bell.
command.murim.tree.no_target: Look at a block within 64 blocks.
command.murim.tree.blocked: No room for the tree there.

technique.murim.heavenly_dragon_strike.w: The ceremonial preparation takes longer than the strike.
technique.murim.thousand_cranes_dance.de: Stand on one leg and flap your arms. Nearby mobs retreat slightly. Cranes are not included.
technique.murim.beggars_crushing_tap.des: Stomp quickly and pump your arms. Each stomp raises a little dust. The opponent remains intact.
technique.murim.beggars_crushing_tap.wea: Only the peace of bystanders is crushed.

murim.junk_art.fake_dance: The movements are memorable. The copyist gives no combat application.
murim.sect.plum.alarm: That is a restricted Mount Hua art! Who gave him permission to use it?
murim.sect.plum.recognized: The Twenty-Four Plum movements! Watch his blade!
murim.penance.warn.secret_art: %s: you have no sect permission to use these Plum forms. This is a serious offence.
murim.sect.merit.summoned: Answer the elders’ summons first. Merit cannot be spent until the sentence is resolved.
dialogue.murim.plum_witness.unauthorized: Stop. How did you learn the restricted Mount Hua forms? Your standing does not permit their use. Another offence will bring penance.
dialogue.murim.plum_witness.recognized: The Twenty-Four Plum Blossom movements… Come here. Do not display this art carelessly. Tell me how you came to understand it.
dialogue.murim.plum_witness.opt.answer: I will hear the elder out.
command.murim.sect.boxes.no_site: No Mount Hua site exists in this world yet. No boxes were placed.
command.murim.sect.boxes.already: A sketch already exists or its labels are still being cleared. Use /murim sect boxes clear, then retry.

dialogue.murim.social.junior.outsider.1: Ah, those seeking strength must climb the mountain on their own feet.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.outsider.2: Listen, the head receives visitors. This yard is for practice.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.outsider.3: Well, we notice a stranger’s sword before learning their name.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.outsider.4: Between us, mount Hua may be poor, but its name is not for sale. What brings you?
dialogue.murim.social.junior.punished.1: Ah, after punishment, deeds speak. Start with the basics.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.punished.2: Listen, the sect remembers an offence, but allows you to mend it.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.punished.3: Well, a bow does not erase responsibility. Serve your sentence.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.punished.4: Between us, let every movement be cleaner than your excuses.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.review.1: Ah, your sword spoke well at the review. Do not let it grow conceited.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.review.2: Listen, winning a review begins your work; it does not earn a holiday.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.review.3: Well, even the kitchen is discussing your last bout.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.review.4: Between us, a fine review. Now try defeating your own laziness.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.secret.1: Ah, that art is not taught in an ordinary formation. Who taught you?
dialogue.murim.social.junior.secret.2: Listen, the yard fell silent after that move. Guard that knowledge.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.secret.3: Well, a powerful art needs judgment, not an audience.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.secret.4: Between us, they are already retelling your technique. Let skill keep ahead of rumour.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.loot.1: Ah, the supplies reached the sect. Your sword served everyone today.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.loot.2: Listen, what you brought will remain in our merit ledger.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.loot.3: Well, back with supplies? Good. Do not mistake the sect’s share for your own.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.loot.4: Between us, a full storeroom strengthens Mount Hua as much as a fine strike.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.friendly.1: Ah, i remember your help. We can speak without ceremony today.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.friendly.2: Listen, your favour made the work easier. Thank you.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.friendly.3: Well, good to see you. That kindness is not forgotten.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.friendly.4: Between us, there is always time for someone who keeps their word.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.morning.1: Ah, dawn is here. Your sword should wake as well.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.morning.2: Listen, morning forms come before breakfast, not in its place.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.morning.3: Well, yesterday’s practice cannot replace today’s basics.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.morning.4: Between us, morning is short. Begin with steady breathing.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.evening.1: Ah, evening shows what remains of the day’s effort.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.evening.2: Listen, put the sword away, but remember today’s mistakes.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.evening.3: Well, quiet at last. What did today teach you?
dialogue.murim.social.junior.evening.4: Between us, the day is ending. Tomorrow we start with the basics again.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.night.1: Ah, the mind should rest at night. The sword can wait for dawn.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.night.2: Listen, quiet. Tomorrow the disciples will complain about lost sleep again.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.night.3: Well, if it can wait, come back in the morning.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.night.4: Between us, night on the mountain. The watches stay awake; the rest conserve their strength.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.ordinary.1: Ah, your standing is %2$s. Let your deeds match it.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.ordinary.2: Listen, you represent Mount Hua today. Remember your standing: %2$s.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.ordinary.3: Well, being %2$s does not exempt you from the basics.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.ordinary.4: Between us, the sect has work for you. Your current standing is %2$s.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.title.1: Greetings, %1$s. The juniors await your example.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.title.2: %1$s, the formation has been asking about you.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.title.3: Make way for the %1$s! Let me put my sword away…
dialogue.murim.social.junior.title.4: %1$s, will you show us a form today?
dialogue.murim.social.junior.weak.1: That standing, with that stance? Even rice stands firmer.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.weak.2: You have the title. Where is the qi? The coach will notice.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.weak.3: I joke, but you really should practise your basics.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.weak.4: We are juniors. You cannot hide behind us any longer.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.strong.1: I will bow. And move. Away from that sword.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.strong.2: Your qi is stronger than mine. May I ask about my stance later?
dialogue.murim.social.junior.strong.3: Senior, the way is clear. I am certainly not scared!
dialogue.murim.social.junior.strong.4: Between us: I wish I had strength like that.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.equal.1: We are about equal. Shall we test that in the ring?
dialogue.murim.social.junior.equal.2: Let us spar. The loser cannot complain about breakfast.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.equal.3: My qi is no weaker than yours. Just spare my face.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.equal.4: A shared realm cannot tell us whose sword is better. A bout?
dialogue.murim.social.junior.lower.1: Start with breathing. Even I used to trip over my feet.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.lower.2: Do not rush into flashy forms. Basics save teeth.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.lower.3: Weak qi is no disgrace. Missing formation is another matter.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.lower.4: Will you train with us? It is easier to stay awake together.

dialogue.murim.social.second.weak.2: Your qi is too unsteady for your standing.
dialogue.murim.social.second.weak.3: Work on the basics first. Fame can wait.
dialogue.murim.social.second.weak.4: If a junior topples you, we will all be embarrassed.
dialogue.murim.social.second.strong.1: I acknowledge your strength. Pass; I will make room.
dialogue.murim.social.second.strong.2: Your breathing runs deeper than mine. I can learn from you.
dialogue.murim.social.second.strong.3: A bow to a strong sword. May it defend our sect’s name.
dialogue.murim.social.second.strong.4: Our generation notices breakthroughs like that. Well done.

dialogue.murim.social.second.equal.2: Equal strength; let us see who wastes fewer movements.
dialogue.murim.social.second.equal.3: Shall we take the ring? No grudges, no lethal strikes.
dialogue.murim.social.second.equal.4: Equal qi is a good reason to test our sword basics.
dialogue.murim.social.second.lower.1: There is a path to our realm. Do not shortcut it with borrowed arts.
dialogue.murim.social.second.lower.2: Your sword is still running ahead of your breathing.
dialogue.murim.social.second.lower.3: We do not bully juniors with strength. Train, and catch up.
dialogue.murim.social.second.lower.4: Watch your feet, not the blossoms around the blade.

murim.sect.request.completed: Favour completed. The reward is in your merit ledger.
dialogue.murim.social.opt.requests: How can I help the sect?
dialogue.murim.social.opt.decline: I decline for now. We can discuss it later.
dialogue.murim.social.business: Offices are earned by deeds, and favours entrusted to those who keep their word. What shall we discuss?
dialogue.murim.social.offer.first.1: You earned the First Disciple of Yul office: first realm, 60 merit, a review victory and service. A new responsibility within your generation. Will you accept?
dialogue.murim.social.offer.first.2: I offer you leadership of the third generation. You have a real review and service behind you, not merely a loud sword. Agreed?
dialogue.murim.social.offer.first.3: Mount Hua needs a First Disciple of Yul. Your deeds give you the right to accept, and the right to decline.
dialogue.murim.social.offer.first.4: The First Disciple leads by example. Scriptures and the head’s audience open to you; rewards of two merit or more gain one extra. Ready?
dialogue.murim.social.ceremony.first: Before ancestors and disciples: First Disciple of Yul. Lead the juniors and guard the basics. Your generation remains unchanged.
dialogue.murim.social.offer.elder.1: Peak realm, 150 merit, a review, the vault, teaching juniors and defending roads. The council offers you an Elder’s office. Will you accept?
dialogue.murim.social.offer.elder.2: You already lead a generation. It is time to care for the whole mountain. The council is ready to name you Elder.
dialogue.murim.social.offer.elder.3: Your service is proven. I offer you an Elder’s office for the sake of those who follow us.
dialogue.murim.social.offer.elder.4: An Elder may enter the treasury and council homes; service merit rises by half, at least one extra point. Ready to answer for our mountain?
dialogue.murim.social.ceremony.elder: Before Mount Hua’s council: Elder. May your word protect our people as your sword does.
dialogue.murim.social.declined: Your refusal is accepted. Our trust remains. Raise the matter yourself when you are ready.
dialogue.murim.social.requests.1: The mountain needs swords and care. Choose work you can do.
dialogue.murim.social.requests.2: A favour is voluntary. Once accepted, keep your word.
dialogue.murim.social.requests.3: How will you help Mount Hua? I will explain before you agree.
dialogue.murim.social.requests.4: Service earns merit. Empty promises earn nothing.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.1: Finished the second lesson and reached the second realm? Prove restraint: win a new review after accepting. Then I will grant vault permission and 8 merit.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.2: Old fame does not open the vault. Accept the favour, win the next review and return for permission.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.3: A new review is needed: show that a strong sword can practise restraint. After victory you earn the vault access flag.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.4: Permission is entrusted to the proven. Finish the second lesson, reach the second realm, then win a new review. That is the path.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.acti: Favour accepted. You now need a new review victory. Return to Tae Rok or the head for permission.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.done: Vault permission granted. Guards and the iron door by the seal recognise it. Receive 8 merit.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.1: After the second lesson and second realm, lead a session: win spars against three different Yul disciples. No lethal strikes. Earn 6 merit and scripture access.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.2: The juniors need an example. Accept and win three teaching spars against different Yul disciples.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.3: Three bouts with one disciple do not count. We need a session for three different juniors.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.4: Explain with sword and restraint. Spar with three different Yul disciples, then report to me for scripture access.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.a: The session is yours. Win spars against three different Yul disciples; report to the coach, Tae Seong or the head.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.d: The juniors received their lesson. Here are 6 merit and scripture permission.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.1: I will give you three Snow Plum pills. Take them to Gyeong Cho at the medicinal pavilion for 6 merit.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.2: The healer needs three Snow Plum pills. You receive them on accepting; only Gyeong Cho accepts delivery.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.3: These pills are for the wounded, not your breakthrough. Give all three to Gyeong Cho.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.4: The treasury has accounts; the healer has patients. Deliver the three supplied pills to the medicinal pavilion.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.acti: Pills received. Give three Snow Plum pills to Gyeong Cho. Others cannot accept them.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.done: All three pills arrived. The wounded will be grateful. Your 6 merit is recorded.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.1: Accept a road patrol and defeat three bandits in the Overworld. Report back for 10 merit and a Snow Plum pill.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.2: Bandits trouble the roads again. Three bandit victories after accepting will prove your service.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.3: Mount Hua needs a patrol, not your vanity. Three bandits, then return for your reward.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.4: Teaching juniors does not defend a road. Only real bandits defeated after accepting count here.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.ac: Patrol begun. Defeat three bandits; report to Gyeong Tak, Tae Seong or the head.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.do: The road is safer. Receive 10 merit and a Snow Plum pill.
dialogue.murim.social.time.morning.3: Morning does not wait for the lazy.
dialogue.murim.social.time.day.1: The yard expects work during the day.
dialogue.murim.social.time.day.2: There is still time to practise before evening.
dialogue.murim.social.time.day.3: Today’s training has not been cancelled.
dialogue.murim.social.time.day.4: The day’s work shows in the evening.
dialogue.murim.social.time.evening.1: Evening is time to review mistakes.
dialogue.murim.social.time.evening.4: Let us talk before the night’s rest.
dialogue.murim.social.time.night.2: Night at the posts, rest in the yards.
dialogue.murim.social.time.night.3: Leave a long talk until morning.
dialogue.murim.social.time.night.4: Dawn will soon demand your strength.

book.murim.mountain_thunder_fist: Close to arm reach. Pull the fist, turn the shoulders, and step through the punch. Weapons do not strengthen the fist. The long recovery invites a counterattack.
book.murim.rift_palm: Hold the open palm in front of the face, fingers together. Gather the red spiral at the wrist and drive it forward. Mastery widens its reach, but stone stops it. This is force, not poison.
book.murim.clear_sky_sword: Learn Six Harmonies Sword to its seventh star. Draw back the blade and trace one fast arc. Mastery opens two, then three contacts on that arc; they share one damage budget.
book.murim.high_cloud_steps: Activate and move: eight to fourteen blocks per second. At the third star a long leap opens for half a qi point. The step never teleports; water and riding end it.
book.murim.quiet_heart_guard: At Peak, settle your breath before combat. This mantle partly reduces direct damage and the pressure of stronger foes. It continuously drains qi; a mature mantle warns when a dangerous presence enters nearby.
book.murim.four_horizons: Seek this rare manuscript in End City treasure. It requires the 9th star of Clear Sky Sword and the 6th star of Quiet Heart Guard. Fix the target centre at the end of preparation. Up to four short attacking horizons share one damage budget. Leaving the circle evades the form.
murim.guest.spar_won: Cho Gan: a precise strike. Take this page; the lesson reward is given once.
murim.guest.spar_end: Cho Gan: enough. Step back and catch your breath.
murim.guest.kwon_phase: Kwon Yeon: first check whom you struck! Step away from the pulse.
npc.murim.ha_yun.title: Cult agent
dialogue.murim.guest_ha_yun.contract: I will investigate the camp. Leave our people alone.
dialogue.murim.guest_ha_yun.greet: A smile does not make a contract cheaper. A courier vanished at a camp. Want to know who is behind it?
dialogue.murim.guest_ha_yun.lead: Start with the Green Forest camps. Defeat Han Dok, then look for Kwon Yeon. Leave your allies alone today.
dialogue.murim.guest_ha_yun.challenge: I challenge you. Give me time to step away.
dialogue.murim.guest_ha_yun.identity_lin: A borrowed seal does not reveal its master. My contract is honest for now. Break it and we test our strength.
npc.murim.cho_gan.title: Wandering rival
dialogue.murim.guest_cho_gan.lesson: Teach me to read a heavy windup.
dialogue.murim.guest_cho_gan.spar: Let us begin a practice duel.
dialogue.murim.guest_cho_gan.greet: Strike harder and you tire sooner. Show me what you need that strength for.
dialogue.murim.guest_cho_gan.lesson_line: Step sideways after the windup. Strike once during recovery and withdraw. Your first victory earns a Six Harmonies page.
npc.murim.bae_do.title: Merchant informant
dialogue.murim.guest_bae_do.greet: Silver first, information later. My invoices are clean... if you skip the fine print.
dialogue.murim.guest_bae_do.tip_line: Han Dok guards a bandit camp. Once he falls, Kwon Yeon will arrive there. I never said the road was safe.
dialogue.murim.guest_bae_do.known_line: Your information is paid for. Han Dok, then Kwon Yeon; my debt is settled.
dialogue.murim.guest_bae_do.price_line: Truth costs more. A convenient lie costs even more. This time you buy a lead, not a promise.
npc.murim.tae_hyeon.title: Righteous Alliance inspector
dialogue.murim.guest_tae_hyeon.report: Report the lead about Kwon Yeon.
dialogue.murim.guest_tae_hyeon.greet: Victory begins the report. The Alliance is investigating missing couriers. Who will pay for your decision?
dialogue.murim.guest_tae_hyeon.purpose_l: We verify leads instead of accusing a school blindly. Bring the merchant's paid tip or the agent's contract. A disciple earns three merit once.
dialogue.murim.guest_tae_hyeon.reported_: The source is recorded; it is not proof of guilt yet. Your merit for reporting is already recorded. Next we investigate the camp.
npc.murim.han_dok.title: Green Forest lieutenant
dialogue.murim.guest_han_dok.greet: The road belongs to the Green Forest. Hear qi charging? Step sideways. There will be no second warning.
npc.murim.kwon_yeon.title: Sorcerer of borrowed voices
dialogue.murim.guest_kwon_yeon.greet: Your thoughts are louder than your steps. I know why you came. The courier has escaped; now we test you.
dialogue.murim.guest_kwon_yeon.voices_li: First check whom you struck. False figures cannot hurt you. Footwork evades the real sword; distance avoids the pulse.
dialogue.murim.progression.menu: Sect affairs: training, duties and relationships. What shall we discuss?
dialogue.murim.progression.training: Tae Seong accepts graduates after spars with three different partners and a favour for the elders. Tae Rok keeps the archive: basics for disciples, Seven Plum for graduates, Twenty-four Plum for trusted members. Study only what you already know.
dialogue.murim.progression.direct: You remain in the Yul generation. Nine bows express your promise to learn; you may pause the ceremony and finish later. After a new spar I can review your foundation, at most once a day.
dialogue.murim.progression.ceremony: Your bows and promise are received. Confirm discipleship after five seconds. If you close this conversation, return to the ceremony.
dialogue.murim.progression.archive: Review grants 5% of the current star’s experience, once a day across the archive. You need sufficient standing, the known technique and a place in the Hall of Scriptures. These records grant no vault pass.
dialogue.murim.progression.duties: Optional duties: supply — 16 oak planks and 8 bread, 4 merit and one day of supplies (+5% mastery); patrol — gate, training ground, dining hall and return, 5 merit. An accepted duty waits without a deadline. Start and claim at most once per day; declining carries no penalty.
dialogue.murim.progression.report: Let us check supplies or the route and your return to the assignment point. You can return days later: progress is saved, rewards are paid once.
dialogue.murim.progression.opt.rival: Discuss a rematch with Seo Ho
dialogue.murim.progression.relations: Seo Ho offers a rematch every two days. The head announces news once a week. After an offence, apologise to the victim, then bring Tae Seong 8 bread to reopen special lessons and duties. Restitution grants no merit.
dialogue.murim.progression.discipline: Assaulting a brother or entering a restricted hall costs up to three available merit; standing is preserved. The reason was explained when it happened. After penance, apologise to the last victim and complete one restitution duty.
dialogue.murim.progression.direct_done: You are now my personal disciple. Your generation and office remain the same.
dialogue.murim.progression.lesson_done: Review complete: +10% of your foundation’s current star experience. The next lesson requires a new spar and a new day.
dialogue.murim.progression.read_done: Record reviewed. Return another day for the next reading.
dialogue.murim.progression.duty_active: Duty recorded. Patrol coordinates appear in chat. Return to the assignment point before the day ends.
dialogue.murim.progression.duty_done: Duty verified, merit awarded. The next duty is available another day.
dialogue.murim.progression.abandoned: Duty abandoned without penalty. A new assignment is available another day.
dialogue.murim.progression.apology_done: Apology heard. Once any sentence is served, Tae Seong will accept 8 bread as restitution.
dialogue.murim.progression.repair_done: Trust restored. Special lessons and assignments are available again.
dialogue.murim.progression.council_done: This week’s announcement is recorded. Reading it again grants no merit.
dialogue.murim.progression.council.dange: Council: bandits have been seen near the sect. Watch the road and protect juniors.
dialogue.murim.progression.council.rain: Council: rain continues. Training takes place under shelter.
dialogue.murim.progression.council.suppl: Council: supplies have arrived; the hall is provided for today.
dialogue.murim.progression.council.peace: Council: the nearby road is quiet. Continue your training and duties.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.stage.0: Seo Ho: let us start with single cuts. I will remember our bout.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.stage.1: Seo Ho: now try holding your ground through two cuts.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.stage.2: Seo Ho: three cuts in succession. Watch the windup as well as the blade.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.won: You won last time. Let us see how the rematch goes.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.lost: Your last defeat is a chance to learn, never an offence.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.new: Allow two days between our meetings.

book.murim.mastery: Stars measure execution of an art, shared by all its learned forms. At zero, the form is known but has no qi manifestations. Mastery improves power and precision, reduces qi use and enriches effects. The final stars require experience and insight through sparring, meditation or a mentor’s review. Footwork arts are complete at ten stars; other arts and cultivation methods at twelve; a torn manuscript reveals only part of the path.
